title: Surface Truth + Pull Readability
purpose: Make suction locomotion agree with visible crawlable geometry and make each plant-load-pull-handoff step perceptually causal without expanding controls or traversal scope.
allowedScope: shared local contact point/normal for stand-off, tangent motion, and tendril anchors
attached pull cadence and handoff hesitation
Core contact deformation aligned to visible surface and loaded anchor
fallback to authored movement envelope when no visible surface truth is available
forbiddenScope: new player buttons or manual tendril selection
general wall/ceiling traversal guarantees or edge wrapping
acceptanceTests: on a broad visible surface, the Core remains beside that mesh rather than sinking toward a mismatched ellipsoid shell
suction pads, stand-off correction, and attached tangent movement use the same visible surface point/normal
a newly sealed forward anchor produces a visible stronger pull window
when no forward anchor exists, the Core hesitates while the next tendril plants instead of skating continuously
the load-bearing tendril and Core silhouette visibly agree about pull direction
free-space movement and all locked gameplay systems remain unchanged
